title: Original AAS2 mathematics companion activity drafts
copyrightPolicy: Original AAS2-authored maths prompts. Verified publisher unit titles are used only for Macmillan Mathematics 2A/2B. Maths Xpress Book 2 uses an explicitly labelled AAS2 companion path; its unit titles are not claimed to be publisher chapter titles. No textbook wording or exercises are reproduced.
requiredChecks: check number range and prerequisite sequence
review word-problem clarity and cultural context
